summary: We are looking for a highly motivated and organized professional to join our team as an Outreach Coordinator. The successful candidate will be responsible for executing structured daily outreach through email, calls, and LinkedIn, engaging with universities, and managing inbound interest.
responsibilities: Execute structured daily outreach through email, calls, and LinkedIn.
Engage with Indian and global universities while managing inbound interest.
Conduct detailed research on universities, programs, and key stakeholders; maintain and update databases.
Schedule and coordinate meetings between university officials and internal leadership.
Assist in preparing proposals, documentation, and follow-up communication.
Collaborate with internal teams to gather inputs and track progress effectively.
required_skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Persistence with a strong outreach-driven mindset
High sense of ownership with a proactive, entrepreneurial attitude
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and basic documentation
nice_to_have_skills: Prior exposure to EdTech, higher education, or academic partnerships
Comfortable making occasional calls across time zones
benefits: Outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential
